title: Inverted Triangle Face Shape: The Measurements Behind the Label

tables.section: The table: five checks, two columns
tables.caption: Bands below are the published centre plus or minus one standard deviation, read on the tape scale. Ratios carry no units; the jaw angle is in degrees. This site counts an inverted triangle inside the heart column and does not list an eighth shape — so the heart column is the one to read against, there is no separate inverted-triangle column, and the numbers in it are the numbers behind that label.
